summary: Pear-shaped diamond solitaire studs with a clean, minimal setting. Explore the size references and enquire for your preferred pair.
description:
A simple pear-shaped diamond brings a soft point of light to each ear. The minimal prong setting keeps the diamond at the centre of the design.

The supplied photographs show four size references labelled 1.00, 2.00, 3.00 and 4.00 ct. Confirm individual and total diamond weight, diamond origin, metal and pricing with our atelier when choosing your pair. The necklace shown in the styling video is sold separately.
